independence_evidence: Founder-run title with a two-person team (founder/editor and managing director) selling direct from its own Squarespace shop (https://sonshinemagazine.com/about); no media-group ownership.
qualifies_reason: Independent London parenting magazine with print Issue 31 on sale and Issue 32 on pre-order.
what_it_is: A quarterly parenting magazine about raising boys without gender stereotypes, with each issue built around a theme such as masculinity, clothes, bodies or books. It mixes advice articles, interviews, recipes, crafts, book reviews and puzzle pages for children. It is for parents and carers of boys who want a feminist angle on boyhood.
uncertainties: No usable cover: the only Issue 31 product photo shows the magazine on a marble table with a mug (lifestyle shot), and the other listing images are text cards. The issue's publication month is not stated; the shop record was added 2026-06-21, so June 2026 is used, and Issue 32 ('Do Clothes Make the Man?') is listed as a pre-order. Quarterly is the publisher's statement; shop dates (Issue 27 Jan 2025, Issue 31 mid 2026) are consistent with roughly four issues a year but back-issue records were bulk-dated and cannot confirm it.
